newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber still unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber still unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesia tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Monday with no buying interest, traders said.
"We did not sell anything today as there was no buying interest. I think prices will be lower tomorrow because of this bearish trend," said one trader.
"The market does not see any fresh factors which can boost sentiment. This morning, we expected to strike some deals, but nothing has happened," said another trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 46.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for August shipment, 47.25 fob Medan, 46.50 fob Padang and Surabaya and 46.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
They said supply was still tight in the local market.
